issue.title: Show a loading state instead of the offline empty message while connectivity resolves [Viewing and listening to resources Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the viewing and listening to resources audit (#531, epic #526).

**Severity:** Low  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local run of `main` @ `fb634e5`, `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios A.7)

## Summary
Until `useConnectivity` resolves, `ResourcesTab` treats the device as offline (`isOnline: hasResolved && isOnline`, `src/app/tabs/ResourcesTab.tsx:168`). With nothing downloaded, no section is visible, so the offline copy "No resources are on this device yet. Download them from Prepare for Offline." flashes before the sections appear. `ResourcesTab.test.tsx:253` currently asserts this.

## Expected
A loading indicator while connectivity is unresolved, then the sections (or the correct empty state).

## Actual
A.7: the offline empty message flashes, then the sections appear.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Online, with no Prepare for Offline download, open a chapter.
2. Open Resources right away.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] While connectivity is unresolved, show a loading state, not an empty message.
- [ ] Update the unit test that asserts the empty message while unresolved.
- [ ] Android device QA: open Resources right after entering drafting; no flash.

## Related
- Spec: #188, #192
- Related gap: empty TN/TQ sections (same audit)
- Parent audit: #531 (epic #526)
